title: server.set_launch_args (platform → host)
description: Not supported by this csm version: always rejected unsupported (csm builds the launch line itself). Reliable; answered by exactly one host.result (ref = this message's id). Rejected with `expired` when expires_at is past, and with `stale` when the envelope ts is more than 5 min off the host's clock (a command replayed long after it was sent is not run).
